title: [C#] Exported property data loss in tool scripts
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in 4.4, 4.5.1, 4.6.3, main (d7c45b1)

### System information

Godot v4.8.dev.mono (d76b83872) - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Mobile) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.5599) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-10750H CPU @ 2.60GHz (12 threads) - 15.76 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

Setup:
- Have C# tool script had been compiled before
- Modify the script to have uncompiled changes that contain new property definitions
- Values for these properties exist in `PackedScene` or `Resource` file
- Build scripts

Result: 
- Property data is lost for any instances currently loaded by the editor. 
- Saving without reopening the scene or project removes the data from file

Expected:
- Property data is loaded correctly in editor
- Saving doesn't remove data

This can happen normally by pulling changes from source control.

Non-tool scripts don't have this issue since the placeholder script instance has tolerance for missing property definitions while in editor. `CSharpInstance` doesn't look like it does the same, so missing property definitions means immediately dropping the data.

For anyone else who experiences this issue, this can be worked around in a few ways
1. Building the C# code before opening the project
2. Building the C# code with the editor
   - If new properties were only to `Node` classes, reopening scenes without saving should load the data back
   - If new properties were in `Resource` classes, reopen the whole editor

Maybe related to #109698 

### Steps to reproduce

- Open the project in the MRP which is in the folder `empty`
- Build scripts
- Uncomment any property in `Test.cs` and save
- Copy `Main.tscn` from the root of the MRP folder into the project

The project is now in a similar state to having pulled changes from source control
- Build scripts
- Notice the property values in editor are default values instead of what's in the copied `Main.tscn`
- Notice saving doesn't add property values to `Main.tscn` in the project

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[tool-script-data-loss.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/29412403/tool-script-data-loss.zip)
